txt_en: Love is the master key that opens the gates of happiness.
txt_cn: 爱是打开幸福之门的万能钥匙。
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

txt_en: The world spins. We stumble on. It is enough.
txt_cn: 世界快速旋转，我们踉跄前行，就已足够。
author: Colum McCann

txt_en: Reprove thy friend privately; commend him publicly.
txt_cn: 在私下批评你的朋友，在公开场合赞扬他。
author: Solon

txt_en: The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
txt_cn: 弱者永远不懂宽恕，宽恕是强者的品质。
author: 甘地

txt_en: Action is the foundational key to all success.
txt_cn: 行动是所有成功的根本。
author: Pablo Picasso

txt_en: The art of being happy lies in the power of extracting happiness from common things.
txt_cn: 幸福的诀窍在于能从平凡事物中提取快乐。
author: Henry Ward Beecher

txt_en: Children are not things to be molded, but are people to be unfolded.
txt_cn: 孩子不是有待铸造的物料，而是有待启发的人。
author: Jess Lair

txt_en: They always say time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself.
txt_cn: 人们总说时间会改变一切，但改变还是要靠你自己。
author: Andy Warhol

txt_en: The greater the obstacle, the more glory in overcoming it.
txt_cn: 阻碍越大，逾越过去就越光荣。
author: 莫里哀

txt_en: Life is something that happens when you can't get to sleep.
txt_cn: 生活就是那些在你失眠的时候发生的事情。
author: Fran Lebowitz

txt_en: Not hammer-strokes but dance of the water sings the pebbles into perfection.
txt_cn: 使卵石臻于完美的，不是锤击，而是水的且歌且舞。
author: Tagore

txt_en: Some people dream of success, while other people get up and make it happen.
txt_cn: 有些人只是梦想去成功，而其他人却起身让梦想成真。
author: Wayne Huizenga

txt_en: Those who bring sunshine to the lives of others cannot keep it from themselves.
txt_cn: 为他人带来阳光的人，自己也一定会沐浴在阳光下。
author: James Barrie

txt_en: Never bend your head. Always hold it high. Look the world straight in the face.
txt_cn: 永远不要垂下头。要高昂着头，直面这世界。
author: Helen Keller

txt_en: Give whatever you are doing and whoever you are with the gift of your attention.
txt_cn: 无论在做什么，跟谁相处，都要送出这份礼物：保持专注。
author: Jim Rohn

txt_en: Happy people build their inner world. Unhappy people blame their outer world.
txt_cn: 快乐的人建构内心世界，不快乐的人责怪外在世界。
author: T. Harv Eker

txt_en: Keep moving forward, and if it's time to go, it's time.
txt_cn: 保持前进，步履不停，如果是时候该走了，那就顺其自然。
author: Stan Lee

txt_en: We are each responsible for our own life—no other person is or even can be.
txt_cn: 自己的生活只能由自己负责，没有别人，也不会有人代劳。
author: 奥普拉·温弗里

txt_en: It is not worth the while to let our imperfections disturb us always.
txt_cn: 犯不着总是为自己的不完美而烦恼。
author: Henry David Thoreau

txt_en: Be steady and well-ordered in your life so that you can be fierce and original in your work.
txt_cn: 生活中沉稳可靠、井井有条，方能在工作中脱颖而出、不同凡响。
author: Gustave Flaubert

txt_en: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
txt_cn: 勇敢并非没有恐惧，而是克服恐惧，战胜恐惧。
author: Mark Twain
